title: Advance Card Payments on the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement — paying ahead by card.**

### Rule

A resident or a representative whose authority on the customer profile is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or guardianship who pays by card while the household's bank drafting is being re-established makes one advance payment, posted as a payment from the resident or family and applied to the oldest outstanding charge first, any excess staying on the account as a credit balance for the coming statements.

An advance payment is not taken until the ledger carries the returned payment fee owed for every payment reinstated after its return.

Read the other way round: while any payment reinstated after its return lacks the returned payment fee owed for it on the ledger, the advance payment is not yet taken.

### The card payment

The payment is the customer's own act. The tool `submit_advance_payment_8dbe3a8d` is unlocked by the desk and handed over to the customer themselves — the resident or the resident's financial representative — who runs it to pay. The card is charged the amount given and the payment is written to the resident's ledger as a payment from the resident or family by credit card, with a card authorization code issued on the spot; the amount owed on the residency account goes down by the payment, and an amount beyond what is owed stays on the account as a credit balance for the coming statements. The payer sees the authorization code and the new balance.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `assisted_residency_id` | Reference number of the assisted living residency paid toward, as given by the representative who handed over the payment | Identifier |
| `amount` | The payment amount, positive, as confirmed to the payer | US dollars, 2 decimal places |

### Return

On success the payment returns `status` "paid", `payment_reference` (the card authorization code issued for this payment), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `account_balance` (the residency balance in USD after the payment, 2 decimal places; a negative balance is a credit balance held for coming statements). No error return is stated.

### Points of judgement

| Payer | Within this rule? |
|---|---|
| The resident | Yes |
| A daughter recorded as financial power of attorney | Yes |
| A grandson with no recorded authority | No — the rule covers the resident or a representative with one of those authorities |
